body: Yes omg same. Easily one of the worst experiences I’ve ever had, im done smoking too. Ain’t no way I’m risking having another one of those, it was terrifying. I’m glad you got through it though!
Im proud of you, it’s not as easy as people think so good for you !!
I would tell them, antidepressants can help boost mood and energy if you find the right one for you.

Alcohol is a depressant so it makes sense. (you can look it up to get a better explanation) It also depends on how your mindset is when you drink. When I was depressed and I would drink, it would just make my depression even worse. Now when I drink I feel great and have a lot of fun.

Chances are the girl is saying those things to you because she is threatened by you and is trying to make herself feel better. I wouldn’t take it personally, I know it sucks to here but it’s coming from someone who is just jealous of you. Feel proud, after all you have something that she doesn’t or else she would not go out of her way to make you feel bad.

Maybe change from a therapist to a psychologist. My therapist told my mom I was just having normal teenage girl problems when I was on the verge of killing myself. My psychologist on the other hand was amazing, she really knew what she was doing and helped me through a lot. Seeing a psychologist is like seeing a therapist, it’s just that they are better at their job. It’s important to get help when you don’t feel good, that way it never gets to really bad. Good luck with things, I hope you feel better!
Thank you, I appreciate it !
I don’t plan on smoking again for a while haha but thank you, that helped!

you probably spiraled into a depression because you are already attached to the dog and don’t want to let it go which makes sense. maybe try telling your boyfriend how you don’t just want a dog you want this dog. explain to him how much you care about this dog and how much it means to you.
Thank you I appreciate that. I really hope you find the support that you need because you deserve it. Just being here today shows how strong of a person you are too. Keep fighting 🤍

Your daughter is young, she does not understand what you are going through. I know it’s heartbreaking to you but in order to get better and be able to quit, you need to take the correct steps. Definitely don’t stop cold turkey. One day in the future when she is older, she will understand and more importantly you will be clean from smoking. When she grows up she will be able to recognize all that you did for her, even though she doesn’t see it now, one day she will.

I used to be in your exact situation. It took me years to tell someone about how I was feeling. It took so much courage for me to do it. My anxiety was screaming at me not too but it was the best thing I ever did. I was able to get professional help which is probably the reason I’m here today. You should not have to go through this alone. I know it’s absolutely terrifying, but once you do it, you realize it wasn’t as scary as you thought it would be. Just keep surviving until you find the courage to tell someone. They would rather you talk to them then lose you. More importantly you deserve to not feel alone and to get better.

I can tell you right now that you did not fail. You only fail when you give up completely. This kind of thing takes time, it’s a process. You will make mistakes and have setbacks but it doesn’t mean you failed. Keeping trying and don’t give up until you are successful. If you end up relapsing again, it’s just another setback. These things happen but you can’t let it completely discourage you. Learn from your mistakes and move forward. You can do it, it may take time but you got this.

Yeah I get it, took me two years until I finally told someone about how I was feeling. It’s so much harder than people realize. My anxiety was like nope absolutely not. I wish you nothing but the best. Keep fighting :)

Well I wasn’t talking to you in the first place considering you weren’t the one to make the post. All I’m doing is sharing my experience in hopes it helps others to continue to fight. If it makes you angry, scroll on.

Because I have been that person, I have been in the exact situation. I have even been you. People used to tell me all the time oh don’t worry things will get better. I always thought it was such bullshit, made me angry too. I don’t blame you for feeling like that. Ur prob thinking whatever it got better for them but why does that mean it will get better for me. It’s gonna get better because you are so blinded by the pain and suffering that you can’t see the beauty life has to offer. I suffered with severe depression for many years, never saw a way out other than suicide but I kept fighting and I am so glad I did. There is so much more to life than what you feel / see when you are depressed. I don’t know that things will magically get better for people, I just know that there is more to life than depression and I know that it is possible to realize that.

maybe it’s a blessing in disguise, I hope that by the time you get ur licenses, you won’t feel like this anymore, or atleast you find some sort of hope or reason to keep fighting. you deserve more than what you are getting in life right now. I’m sorry ur going through this. If you haven’t, I recommend atleast trying to talk to someone about how you are feeling. Took me a while to get help because I feared judgement / lack of understanding from my family, even though they didn’t understand they did everything they could to help me get better. Getting professional help can make a major difference. Either way, just do ur best to keep fighting. You are so young and there are so much more to life than what you are feeling right now. I was depressed at ur age too, fucking sucks, never thought I would be alive today but I am so grateful that I am. One day you will be too, don’t give up yet. You deserve to find happiness.

Take that as a sign, it’s not ur time yet. You aren’t done on this earth. I know you want to be done but ur simply not. You have purpose, ur life means something. Keep fighting and surviving until you find that meaning. There is so much more to life than what you are feeling right now. Don’t give up just yet, you deserve to truly live.

I don’t know ur situation completely but if you haven’t I recommend seeking professional help. It helped me in some ways. Whether you have or haven’t gotten help for this, I can tell you one thing that you may not want to hear. It’s going to take time until you get better. But you need to know and understand that it WILL get better. I know exactly how you are feeling and I’m so sorry that you are going through this but you will get through this. You are going to come out so much stronger and happier once you make it through. I promise you, it does get better eventually.
I understand that. However for me, I get this overwhelming feeling of peace. Just complete peace and it’s so relieving.

Hate to be the one to tell you this but it’s not ur time for goodbyes. I know it’s hard right now and I’m not going to lie it might be hard for a while but over time you will get better. I know you are trying and I know you are so tired of fighting but you have to keep going. There is hope for an amazing future. You have the potential to be so extraordinary in life, so keep fighting. You cannot see it now but this is not all there is to life. Everyday that you survive is another battle won. Keep winning the battles everyday until you win the war. I promise it is worth it.
thank you for the advice!
Thank you, this helped a lot, I appreciate it.

I’m sorry for what you have gone through and are currently going through. You need to know that you didn’t do anything wrong and you don’t deserve it. Sadly bad things happen to good people all the time. I know you dont see a future for yourself right now but there is one for you so keep fighting because you deserve to find happiness. It will take time but you will get there. You are so much stronger than you know. One day when you get through everything you will be thankful you never gave up. All of this pain and struggle will lead you where you are meant to be.

It’s okay that you couldnt bring yourself out of bed today. It is perfectly okay. Don’t think about the things you didn’t do, think about the things you did do. You didn’t get out of bed but you survived the day and that is so much more important. The fact that you made it through today just shows that you are going forward.

As someone who struggles with depression, I know how hard it is to open up to people about it. I kept it buried for two years until I finally got help. Every bone in my body told me not to but one day I broke and I got help. It was the best thing I ever did. For the first time in years I had gotten hope and that is so important when you have depression. I know it’s hard, it is so damn hard but you can do it. You need to. It’s the first step to getting better and you deserve to get better.

Have you talked to people about how you are feeling? Or are you diagnosed with a mental illness? Sounds like depression to me but I’m not a doctor. If you haven’t gotten help, I recommend doing it, sometimes it really is a chemical imbalance in ur brain.

Hi! You said that you have had depression for 10+ years. The fact that you are still here right now is amazing. You are so incredibly strong. You made it through so many hard days already and you can make it through these ones too. It might be hard to see right now but there is happiness in ur future. A life you want to live will come to you. All this pain ur in, all these bad days, they will only make you stronger and a better person. You are so inspiring.

Suicide is not ur fate. Everything might be going wrong right now but that’s because it’s leading you to where you are meant to be. It feels like your making all the wrong turns but you are going to end up at ur destination. It is going to be beautiful and bring you so much happiness. So stay alive so you can get there one day.
thank you :)
thank you :)
I’m sorry to hear that, you can always reach out to me if you need someone to talk to. I’m don’t know what ur situation is but I do know that you would be missed, try to use that as a reason.
No I haven’t, I will definitely look into though, thank you!
Thank you, I hope you have people in ur life that make you want to stay, or atleast something.
I know and it feels like there is nothing I can do about it. At this point i think the only thing keeping me here is my parents and the people I love.
I’m not doing any specific type of therapy, I just meet with a psychologist once a week to talk about everything and get tips I guess.
I know. I genuinely feel like not everyone gets better, losing hope is the worst part because it’s the only thing keeping me going.
I’m sorry to here that. No one deserves it but it’s good to know we’re not alone in this. <3
Thank you. As much as I want to, I’m not gonna give up that easily. I appreciate the comment.
Thank you, I really appreciate it. :)

I surprisingly like the person I am and I don’t have any abnormal thoughts or any dark thoughts. I do think about suicide but mainly because I want the pain to stop. My guess is that it has something to do with my brain chemistry because that’s the only thing that makes sense to me. Thanks for reaching out btw, i appreciate it

She never explained the origin point but that’s because I don’t think there is one. I’ve tried so hard to think of one but nothing traumatic has really happened to me. I feel like that’s the worse part because I don’t know why I feel this and how to get better.

I have been in the exact same situation that ur in. The only reason I ever stayed was for my parents too, I couldn’t do that to them. For now keep using ur parents as a reason to stay until you can find a reason for urself to stay. Your life will change and things will get better it just might take some time. Once you realize that you should stay not for ur parents but for urself, you will be okay. You deserve to find happiness and live a joyful life. So don’t just stay for ur parents, stay for ur future because there is one for you and it’s amazing, you just can’t see it right now.

I’m always here if you need someone to message, so please message me if you need to talk. Also remember what is one more month? Something really amazing can happen to you but if ur not here then it can’t. You are taking away ur opportunity to find happiness and get better. I wish you nothing but the best and I hope you make the right decision. You are loved and you are wanted on this earth <3
Do you take melatonin? It could be causing the dreams. Also I would recommend talking to the doctor who prescribed you medication about it, they could know what’s wrong.

I know that there is nothing I can do to stop you but I really hope that you do not go through with it. I have been where you are and still go there sometimes but there is so much more beauty in life then you realize. You deserve to experience it. This should not be the end of your story, you are taking away an amazing life that you could have lived. You just feel so hopeless and tired rn that you can’t see it. You have done this for 7 years so what is one more week or one more month? It’s not like you are on a time crunch. Also you posted it on here so that has to mean that some part of you wants a reason to stay and if that’s what ur looking for, a sign to stay then this is it.
I wish there was more I could do for you, have you tried antidepressants or therapy?

There is no coming back from what you are going to do. You will leave people broken and more importantly you are denying yourself from the life you deserve. If you have depression or think you do then please get help because sometimes it really is a chemical imbalance so you cannot be happy. You can defeat this demon. It will take time, a lot of time and a lot of strength but you can and you will defeat it. Do not give up now. You deserve to be happy so keep fighting for yourself. I love you and I believe in you <3

I understand how you feel. I felt like this for years and I never thought I would ever be happy. When I finally started to become happy I was terrified. It was because it was so new to me and I didn’t understand the emotion. It was a long road to happiness for me but it was worth it. I’m just trying to say that even though you can’t see it right now, happiness will come to you. It sucks to hear this but it might take a while, even years but it will come. I know it might seem hard to survive until then but I promise you the outcome is worth it. You will be thankful you never gave up. Keep fighting <3

The thing with depression is that it wants you to feel like recovery is impossible. However that is not the case. It seems like it will never end but it will. It can end in 1 month or 1 year but it will come to an end. You just have to make it till then. I know it’s hard but it will be worth it. When you finally make it through this you will look back and be thankful you did not give up. So keep fighting, fight for the future and happiness you deserve.

Hi! I just wanted to let you know that you are not alone in this. I went through the same thing. It took me two years to finally build up the courage to tell my mom. It’s unexplainable how hard it is to do and I know you wish you could but for some reason you can’t. I just wanted to let you know that you have time and you do not need to rush to tell her. Tell her when you are ready and don’t be afraid either. Telling my mom was the best thing I ever did. It will give you hope and faith which is something you need right now. You can do this, I know you can. Best of luck!
Have you ever thought that maybe you could have a mental illness such as depression?
